steps.title: Free consultation
steps.text: A 20-minute call about your goal, your schedule, your history and anything that's held you back before.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.text: Photos, measurements, movement screen and current eating habits, so we start from facts, not guesses.

steps.title: Your plan
steps.text: Training and nutrition written for you, with clear targets for the next four weeks.

steps.title: Weekly check-ins
steps.text: We review progress every week and adjust. You always know what to do next and why.
